rules.requirement: Platform facts come from trusted current public code. Discovery does not grant execution permission.
Use one explicit business entrypoint and native Dataset composition; ordinary functions and actors retain their native interfaces.
Model requests use native prompt or agent nodes. Business callbacks must not hide model clients, schedulers or nested pipelines.
Pin input identity and scope. Preserve the business denominator and distinguish rejection, empty results, technical failure and completion.
Prompt and model configuration use native versioned formats. Review actual rendered inputs and independent review boundaries.
Declare finite resources, failure, cleanup, reuse and publication boundaries. Native budgets and journals are not replaced by business infrastructure.
Acceptance binds the requirement, rules, code, prompts, configuration, platform and verification implementation. Changes require renewed evidence.
入口和 helper 的实际定义与依赖可解析；职责由调用契约确定，不由业务目录名称确定；没有隐含环境输入或共享可变状态
主数据节点解析到已绑定平台 API；helper 展开后仍全部合规
依据原生签名校验必需参数、名称、重复绑定和可确定值约束
每条 Dataset 的来源、多输入、去向和终结动作可识别
每个表输入绑定允许位置与固定版本，实际引用可读且元数据吻合
依据原生规则传播字段的存在性、null、类型和来源，并核对端口兼容
读写、模型、查询与物化效果明确；运行时值只来自原生查询/回执并用于受限参数和前置检查；不用于改变接线拓扑
接线遵守原生同步/流式、后端及物化约束
自有目标、明确模式/条件/回执；多写入和读写交叠具有原生支持的顺序与版本语义
绑定准确源码/配置/资源/平台/标准闭包和所用工作区权限；无关登记变化不使检查失效；检查器自身具有有限预算
实际定义可定位，依赖闭包和构造参数可绑定
形参、字段绑定、固定参数与 sync/async/actor 协议一致
输入输出结构明确，nullable、返回字段和基数与节点匹配
不接收/创建/执行嵌套 Dataset，不负责表级调度
模型、网络、表写入、服务、进程和调度不藏在计算节点
解析实际符号、接收者和调用闭包；每项外部能力有绑定版本的效果边界
rules.scope: 调用来源与效果可判定

rules.requirement: 无初始化资源副作用；节点协议和预算配置合法，未验证的执行保证单列
rules.scope: 生命周期协议与资源配置

rules.requirement: 阻断已知异常抑制模式；原生错误策略显式可见；不静态证明业务失败语义
Execution binds sealed source, effective parameters, fixed input references and platform/environment identity.
Only declared native local semantics with supported backend composition, bound resources and finite run admission may execute; unknown paths block.

Read registered fixed versions or versions from verified native receipts. Create declared targets or overwrite an explicitly permitted target against a fixed CAS baseline; never follow an unbound latest version.
Match the actual native plan and validate consumed callable inputs and actual return values without coercion.
Persist action intent and native write receipts; verify committed versions before registering outputs; uncertain commits stay unknown.
Apply finite admission, process, data, disk and time budgets; cancel owned work and preserve submitted results.
Track each independent action and preserve partial commits; whole-run success requires every expected action and output.
Results are fixed DatasetRefs backed by native receipts; case comparison uses explicit keys and continuation pins the selected version.
Start, cancel and reconciliation are idempotent control operations; a retry of the same run must not execute it twice.
UI, CLI and Python share run facts; unknown progress, interrupted ownership and missing output versions are explicit.
Native API and pure semantic handlers must come from the bound platform implementation; catalogue JSON cannot grant callable authority.
Discovery, complete contract facts, backend support and workspace admission are distinct. Unknown capability is never supported by default.
Bind machine-readable defaults and declared resources; display repr is not a binding protocol.
Static and actual native execution use the same backend composition rules without a second executor.
Actual source, operation, callable, resource and action facts are independently extracted and checked before effects.
Check actual input, awaited output, emitted rows and bounded expansion against declared structure.
Contract, resource, cancellation and service failures cannot become business misses.
Actor ownership, scope and lifecycle remain native; start failures and partial initialization require owned cleanup.
The checked source and plan reach the action; internal materialization consumers create no business nodes or nested actions.
Admission bounds source, queues, in-flight calls, batches, expansion, diagnostics, disk and time; third-party allocations retain process protection.
Repeated actions have distinct execution instances and cumulative effect budgets; shared upstream does not imply single execution.
Cancellation stops new scheduling, drains bounded work and records incomplete cleanup or uncertain effects without fabricated success.
Request and commit evidence uses exact native references under declared owned roots, with bounded read-only access.
Observations have stable logical identity, monotonic sequence, truthful scope and pre-reserved bounded terminal storage.
A real additional native API with shared semantics must execute without API-name branches in Forge or the UI.
Verify multiple semantic families against independent expected outputs and actual failure boundaries.
Python, CLI and browser use the same admission and facts; read-only viewing never executes an operator.
Old reports and runs remain read-only; changed protocols require new inspection and cannot inherit old execution authority.
